biggest_catch: The company's official shopper domain (mysteryshops.com) is parked for sale — the program appears defunct, and no current official terms exist.
catches: http://www.mysteryshops.com/ resolves to a GoDaddy domain-for-sale page, not a shopper portal.
No current official shopper terms, pay schedule, or payout method could be found.
Forum pay anecdotes ($5-20/shop) are third-party and possibly stale.
This brand is heavily impersonated by money-mule check-cashing scams — a dead official site raises the risk of encountering fakes.

c1.evidence: Corporate Research International was a real mystery shopping company, but its official shopper domain is parked for sale as of 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: No current official pay amounts; forum postings are third-party and possibly stale.

notes: Rejected as dead/defunct: the official shopper domain mysteryshops.com is for sale. Scam note stands and is the key user-facing point: fake 'Corporate Research International' checks ($2,450-2,495 with wire instructions) are documented money-mule scams. Do not engage with anyone recruiting under this name without a live official site.
